title: stryker.com rich-text formatting → EDS authoring (site-wide decision table)
status: Approved 2026-10-27. 'established' rules come from the news-detail import (news-typography.js, measured on 448 news pages) and apply to every template.

evidence.catalog: tools/importer/data/catalog/typography.json — 1,122 combinations, 4.93M characters of authored rich text (pages + XFs); 56 combinations cover 95%, 227 cover 99%
evidence.conventions: https://main--patients-stryker--aemdemos.aem.live/.da/docs/authoring-guide/authoring-conventions (fetched 2026-10-27): bold / italic / bold+italic / bold+underline links; bold+italic headings and text; underlined heading → bottom border
evidence.measured: https://www.stryker.com/us/en/about.html at 1440px, leaf computed style (2026-10-27). Base text = Humanist 712 14px/400 black; fontsize-<x>em = x × 14px and nested classes multiply (1-25 inside 2-5 = 43.75px); fontsize-8em = 0.8em = 11.2px (small print); urw-egyptienne = Egyptienne for Stryker Light 400; futura-bold = Futura for Stryker 700
evidence.sharesAre: % of all authored rich-text characters; 'text' = p / li / div, 'headings' = h1–h6

corpStylesAvailable: section styles in styles/styles-corp.css: p-1, p-1-25, p-1-5, p-1-75, serif (+ serif.p-1-25, serif.p-1-5), h-serif, bold-body, label-1-5, join; bracket colours span.color-gold|blue|purple|teal|navy|grey|white; rule-gold

rules.source: text with no class or colour

rules.outcome: unwrap — corp headings are Futura Bold by default
section style p-1-25 (17.5px) in every template; 'lead' kept as an alias in CSS until the news pages are re-imported

rules.note: news-detail drops this size today; the style exists in styles-corp.css

rules.source: .fontsize-2em / .fontsize-2-5em (28px / 35px, mostly Futura + colour: statistics and callouts)
rules.outcome: dynamic numbers (numbercounter / count-up components) -> Statistics block (component table). Static large text in rich text -> plain text with a size section style: NEW p-2 (28px) and p-2-5 (35px), following the p-* scheme; colour and Futura per the other rules.
rules.note: user 2026-10-27: dynamic -> statistics, static -> normal large text

rules.outcome: NEW section style p-0-8 (0.8em = 11.2px), added to styles-corp.css next to p-1 … p-1-75
section style serif (combined with the size style: serif.p-1-25, serif.p-1-5)
rules.note: approved 2026-10-27; news pages get it on re-import. serif.p-1-75 and serif.p-0-8 combinations to be added to styles-corp.css

rules.outcome: keep as in the source: <i> / <em> -> <em> (italic). Source bold+italic (0.004%) collides with the Futura convention <strong><em>; reported per page, not converted.
keep <sup>/<sub>; drop <u> on non-links (underline = divider / button convention)

rules.source: a component whose blocks use different size / serif styles
rules.outcome: split into consecutive sections, later runs get 'join' (no extra gap)
use the effective size (product) and map it to the nearest size style (p-0-8 ... p-2-5); sizes beyond p-2-5 -> p-2-5

rules.source: 34 editor / translation-tool classes (tw-*, gr_*, vk_*, mso*, …)

colours.rule: exact hex (rgb() normalised to hex) -> bracket colour [[color-<name>]text]. Other colours -> the perceptually closest existing colour (CIELAB dE) among gold, blue, purple, teal, navy, grey, white and default black (= dropped); neutral greys only map to white / grey / default. User 2026-10-27: round to the closest existing colour.

rounded.any other: computed the same way by the transformer
